output.summary: A shrub or small tree from much of Central and South America, especially Mexico and Guatemala; its natural habitat includes seasonally dry tropical forest slopes in the Sierra Madre Occidental. It has fragrant white, funnel-shaped flowers and ribbed capsules containing winged seeds. Its dried bark is traditionally brewed as tea and consumed as both a food beverage and household remedy.
